svg.title: Plain causal mask vs the IPPD branch mask
svg.desc: Rows are queries, columns are keys. Left: a causal mask over the stacked sequence; cells marked ! are a question attending to a different question. Right: the IPPD mask, where each question block sees the shared context and its own earlier tokens only.
svg.text: Rows are tokens doing the looking (queries), columns are tokens being looked at (keys).
Context of 6 tokens, then questions of 3, 2 and 4.
! = a question reading another question. pos = the position ID each token is given. On the right, every question restarts at 6.
